comparative_performance: Execution guard only; no rule, sizing, timing, model, cost or parameter change. The nightly refuses ordinary orders when the broker's /clock reports the market open, because a market-on-open day order sent then could fill at the current price instead of the measured next open. From 2026-12-06 Nasdaq runs a day session from 04:00 to 20:00 ET, so at the 19:30 nightly the broker's flag can be true while the regular session the desk's orders are measured against closed at 16:00; the old guard would have refused every ordinary order and the book would stop rebalancing. The guard now reads the reviewed XNYS calendar (calendar.exchange_status) for the regular session. During the regular session it still refuses; an unknown calendar year falls back to the broker flag; an unreachable broker clock still fails closed. The installed rule, account simulator, policy replay and measured execution are unchanged.
